messages:
nina: Heads-up: staging TLS canary failing to eu-edge-staging at 04:14 UTC. openssl s_client shows "sslv3 alert handshake failure" and no cipher negotiated. Probe dashboard: https://status.redwood/canaries/edge-staging (filtered).
garret: I see that. Nightly key alias rotation completed at ~04:10. Could be alias now pointing to a key without grants. kms-bot: Rotation event - alias/edge-staging-key -> newKeyId=1234-rotated at 2026-03-26T04:09:52Z.
sre-oncall: Did cert-provisioner decrypt the private key ok? Paste relevant logs please.
nina: cert-provisioner snippet: ```
2026-03-26T04:11:04Z cert-provisioner warn: decrypt attempt failed: AccessDeniedException keyId=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111111:key/1234-rotated principal=system:serviceaccount:certs:cert-provisioner
2026-03-26T04:12:30Z cert-provisioner info: retry success after manual grant request request_id=abc987
```
Also proxy logs show client cert verify failed 04:12-04:16 with error "certificate verify failed (unknown issuer)".
garret: Our RBAC changes earlier this week shouldn't affect KMS grants directly, but we rolled a policy that tightens iam:PassRole. k8s audit doesn't show denies. Could be key policy/grant side-effect from rotation job.
kms-bot: Detected key-policy delta in eu-west-1 for key/1234-rotated: removed Allow for principal arn:aws:iam::111111:role/cert-provisioner-role. DeltaID=delta-775.
sec-automations: Important: rotation should atomically create grants matching old key's effective principals. If alias cutover happens before grants applied, transient failures occur. Suggest runbook change.
sre-oncall: Short mitigation plan: 1) create grant for cert-provisioner role on the new key 2) restart cert-provisioner pods 3) reload staging proxy to pick up certs. Proposed command: ```bash
aws kms create-grant --key-id 1234-rotated --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111111:role/cert-provisioner-role --operations Decrypt,DescribeKey --name "cert-prov-grant"
kubectl rollout restart deployment/cert-provisioner -n certs
kubectl exec -n staging deploy/staging-proxy -- nginx -s reload
```
garret: I'll apply the grant and restart things. Also capture `aws kms get-key-policy` before/after and `kubectl logs` for artifacts.
kms-bot: Grant created grantId=grant-yyy at 04:25:13Z. cert-provisioner logs show Decrypt success at 04:26:02Z. Probe success at 04:27:10Z.
sec-automations: Post-incident follow-ups: - Add CI gating that simulates alias rotation in sandbox with a dry-run cert issuance to validate grants creation and decryption. - Emit an audit alert when alias target changes without matching grants for registered principals. - Document rotation ordering: create grants -> update alias -> revoke old grants (when safe).
nina: For the postmortem include: timeline (rotation, failure window), who approved rotation job, runbook gap (no atomic grant+alias step), regional grant oversight (ap-southeast vs eu-west differences), and requested audit retention bump for KMS key-policy changes -> 90d.
garret: Opening ticket SEC-2026-056, assigning to @nina @garret @sre-oncall. I'll attach logs, key-policy diffs, and commands run.
sre-oncall: Quick commands I ran for evidence: ```bash
# key policy diff
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id 1234-rotated --policy-name default > after.json
# cert-provisioner logs
kubectl logs -n certs deploy/cert-provisioner --since=30m | tee certprov.log
# probe recheck
curl -fs https://eu-edge-staging/.well-known/health || true
```
Thanks team. Treating as a near-miss; recommend adding the atomic-rotate test to nightly integration. :thumbsup:
